text: Hello! I'm AI Project Registry. How can I help you today?
Can you find and add me as a Team member to the AP agent project?

I found the project: [AP Agent](https://microsoftcape.sharepoint.com/Lists/Ai%20Projects/DispForm.aspx?ID=11). It is currently active and has no team members listed [1].

I also confirmed the authoritative SharePoint item for AP Agent (ID 11), and its TeamMembers field is currently empty.

However, the update operation is failing due to a SharePoint connector configuration issue in this agent. The connector is returning an error before the membership update can be submitted, so I can't complete the write from here.

If the connector is fixed, I would add:
- MichaelG@MicrosoftCAPE.onmicrosoft.com

to the AP Agent project's Team Members list without overwriting any existing members.

At the moment, the project has been located successfully, but I was unable to perform the actual membership update because of the connector error.

text: is the error that the connector passes {dataset} instead of the actual dataset?

Yes, that's what the error suggests.

The update call is returning:

- "SharePoint Site Address '{dataset}' is not valid"

That message indicates the connector is receiving the literal string "{dataset}" instead of a resolved SharePoint site URL. In other words, a parameter substitution appears not to be happening before the request is sent.

A few observations:

- Get item works correctly against the same list, so the SharePoint connection itself is functional.
- Both update actions (`Updateitem` and `Updateitem_PatchItem`) fail before processing the item payload.
- The failure occurs even when I try to explicitly provide the site URL, which suggests the update action may be misconfigured internally rather than the data I'm sending being wrong.
- The error occurs before SharePoint evaluates the TeamMembers field, so it's not currently a person-field formatting issue.

Based on the behavior, the most likely root cause is that the update action's configured "Site Address" parameter is being passed as the unresolved token `{dataset}` rather than the actual SharePoint URL. That would explain why reads work while writes fail.

Once that connector configuration is corrected, I should be able to add you to the AP Agent project.
what is the dataset that we are passing to the connector?

From the tool definitions available to me, the configured SharePoint site URL for this project registry is:

- https://microsoftcape.sharepoint.com/

The list identifier is:

- a0948281-a8b4-4671-848e-4476b3b9b444

Evidence:

- The knowledge search results point to the "Ai Projects" list at:
  https://microsoftcape.sharepoint.com/Lists/Ai%20Projects
- The Get Item call successfully retrieved AP Agent (ID 11) from that list.

What's unusual is that the update connector error isn't saying that https://microsoftcape.sharepoint.com/ is invalid. It's saying:

- SharePoint Site Address '{dataset}' is not valid

That implies the connector runtime is receiving the literal placeholder `{dataset}` instead of the value `https://microsoftcape.sharepoint.com/`.

So the dataset value that should be used is:

- https://microsoftcape.sharepoint.com/

but the update action appears to be receiving:

- {dataset}

which indicates a parameter binding/configuration problem in the action itself.
